name: 记忆
description: Memory Ocean: cross-session memories the agent saves and recalls on its own, shown as a living star map; plus optional curated memory tracks and explicit, reviewable project-memory consolidation.

features.name: 记忆之海：智能体保存、合并与取代跨会话记忆
features.nameEn: Memory Ocean: cross-session memories the agent saves, merges and supersedes

features.name: 按任务召回记忆（本地词法排序，每轮固定）
features.nameEn: Task-matched memory recall (local lexical ranking, fixed per run)

features.name: 记忆星图：关联、星座、召回脉冲与编辑
features.nameEn: Memory star map: links, constellations, recall pulses and editing

features.name: 只读记忆轨道与上下文注入
features.nameEn: Read-only memory tracks and context injection

features.name: 显式项目记忆整理、候选审阅与确认应用
features.nameEn: Explicit project memory curation, candidate review and confirmed application

features.name: 手动编辑与版本冲突检测
features.nameEn: Manual editing and version conflict checks

features.name: 记忆能力与工作区配置
